newsitem.title: USA: Advisory firm endorses Coastal in proxy fight.
newsitem.headline: Advisory firm endorses Coastal in proxy fight.

text.p: Coastal Physician Group Inc said Friday that Institutional Shareholder Services Inc recommended that its clients vote for Coastal management's nominees to the board of directors at the company's September 27 annual meeting.
"We recommend that shareholders vote in favor of management's nominees to the board," ISS said.
"We believe the strategic plan set forth by manangement is necessary to maintain Coastal as a viable entity given the company's financial position," the advisory firm said.
In July, Steven Scott, a director of Coastal Physician and owner of about 30 percent of its stock, said he planned to solicit support for the selection of two new independent directors.
In a statement released in July, Scott said he was concerned that "company's current leadershop is weak and ineffective."
Coastal is a physician contract management services company.
